Mapping rules: The Workbench does not transform source data at load. There is no load. A rename or a type cast happens in the recovery.v_ace_* view.
The view field is named for the Workbench. The ACE column name appears only in the view definition and the ACE mapping tab of the LDM.

payment.pay_date is varchar in ACE and becomes date through recovery.ace_to_date, which returns NULL rather than failing. account.is_restructured and customer.is_deceased are Y/N text and become boolean through recovery.ace_to_boolean.

customer.identification_number is never exposed in clear. v_ace_customer returns id_no_masked and id_no_last4. Phone, email and address are exposed in full because notices need them; display masking is E1-037 at the API.
The business date is read from recovery.v_ace_batch_status, one row per source and business date, written by ACE ingestion (RWB-ACE-001). No row carries a Workbench load date.
Source codes map to Workbench lists in the view or in the list load, not in a load-time map table. LOV-ACTION-CODE reads v_ace_efs_action_code.
Amounts are numeric(18,2) in baht. ACE numeric(38,2) columns are cast in the view where the Workbench column is narrower.
A field ACE does not hold is raised once in RWB-ACE-001 and then read from its view. It never becomes a Workbench column.
A Workbench link to a source record is a business key (varchar 255) with no foreign key. The 14 re-keyed links are listed in the Tier Map.
Ready means the field is in an ACE table today. Waiting on RWB-ACE-001 means the field is in the ACE story and the dependent feature stays behind its flag.
